correctness.rationale: Complete XOR line enumeration creates 35 lines and 3,048 nonempty faces. 1,484 disjoint Morse pairs are certified acyclic by a full 3,048-node/13,770-arc topological sort; critical dimensions are (0:1,3:1,4:78). Exact signed gradient-path coefficients are -2 on 15 critical four-cells, 0 on 44, and +2 on 19, so the integer attaching-degree ideal equals 2Z. Since the reduced CW skeleton is S^3 and pi_3(S^3) is Z, integral column operations identify one degree-two Moore attachment plus 77 trivial four-cell attachments. Direct unreduced simplicial mod-two and mod-three rank checks confirm the predicted field homology.

value.rationale: The binary projective three-space PG(3,2) is the canonical fifteen-point 35-line Steiner triple system. Its full cap complex is nonpure, with maximal caps of sizes five and eight, and its nonzero two-primary torsion precludes a wedge of spheres. The exact Moore attachment and 77-sphere count provide a motivated complete integral homotopy classification inaccessible from cap cardinality alone or rational homology. This is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a renamed consequence of a known geometric classification.
